3d1756.title: CONFIRMED: Stored XSS in news body (attribute-boundary bypass of on-handler regex)
3d1756.content:
AREA 5 - Stored XSS confirmed. Root cause: NewsController::sanitizeNewsContent() and views/public/berita-detail.php use strip_tags($html, '


    1. ') which PRESERVES attributes on allowed tags. The naive regex `preg_replace('/[\s\/]on[a-z]+\s*=\s*("[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'|[^\s>]+)/i', ...)` only strips on-handlers preceded by whitespace or '/'. Prefixing any attribute with a quote closes the previous attribute, so the next on-handler is NOT preceded by \s or / and survives. Payload:
